# Populi API2 reference

> A local copy of Populi's API2 reference (https://populi.co/api/), rebuilt for agents by `populi-docs`. Do not edit by hand; run `populi-docs sync` to refresh. Docs version: 2026-09-21 11:05:10 PST. 177 models, 682 endpoints.

Start with the overview for how every request works. To find an endpoint, search `reference/endpoints.md` (one line per endpoint), then open its model page for fields, parameters, filter conditions, expands, permissions, and examples.

## Start here

- [Overview](reference/overview.md): authentication, request and response format, expandable objects, paging, filter conditions, errors, rate limits
- [Endpoints](reference/endpoints.md): every endpoint, one line each, sorted by path
- [Catalog](reference/catalog.json): the same reference as JSON, for programs; no examples
- [Changes](CHANGES.md): what changed in Populi's reference, per sync
